{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |CoachRank = |APRank = |year = 2020–21 |team = Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets |sport = Basketball |image = Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets logo.svg |image_size = 150 |conference = Atlantic Coast Conference |division = |short_conf = ACC |record = 17–9 |conf_record = 11–6 |head_coach = [[Josh Pastner]] |hc_year = 5th |asst_coach1 = [[Eric Reveno]] |asst_coach2 = Julian Swartz |asst_coach3 = Anthony Wilkins |asst_coach4 = |stadium = [[McCamish Pavilion]] |champion = [[2021 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] champions |tourney = [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = first round }} {{2020–21 ACC men's basketball standings}} The '''2020–21 Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets men's basketball team''' represented the [[Georgia Institute of Technology]] during the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were led by fifth-year head coach [[Josh Pastner]] and played their home games at [[Hank McCamish Pavilion]] as members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the Yellow Jackets finished the season 17–9, 11–6 in [[2020–21 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in fourth place. They defeated [[2020–21 Miami Hurricanes men's basketball team|Miami]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2021 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] and advanced to the championship game after [[2020–21 Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball team|Virginia]] was forced to withdraw from the tournament after a positive COVID-19 test.{{cite web|title=Virginia Cavaliers out of ACC tournament after positive COVID-19 test|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/31050993/virginia-cavaliers-acc-tournament-positive-covid-19-test|work=ESPN|first=Jeff|last=Borzello|date=March 12, 2021|access-date=March 12, 2021}} They defeated [[2020–21 Florida State Seminoles men's basketball team|Florida State]] to win the tournament championship{{Cite web|title=Georgia Tech vs. Florida State - Game Recap - March 13, 2021 - ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401301257|access-date=2021-08-24|website=ESPN.com|language=en}} and received the conference's automatic bid to the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 9 seed in the Midwest region.{{Cite web|last=Easwaran|first=Akshay|date=2021-03-14|title=Georgia Tech Basketball: Jackets Earn #9 seed, will play #8 Loyola-Chicago|url=https://www.fromtherumbleseat.com/2021/3/14/22330637/georgia-tech-basketball-jackets-earn-9-seed-will-play-8-loyola-chicago-march-madness-ncaa-tournament|access-date=2021-08-24|website=From The Rumble Seat|language=en}} They lost in the first round to [[2020–21 Loyola Ramblers men's basketball team|Loyola]].{{Cite web|title=Georgia Tech vs. Loyola Chicago - Game Recap - March 19, 2021 - ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401310903|access-date=2021-08-24|website=ESPN.com|language=en}} It was the first time since 2010 that the Yellow Jackets had participated in the NCAA Tournament, and their first ACC Championship since 1993. ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets men's basketball team|Yellow Jackets]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 17–14, 11–9 in [[2019–20 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in fifth place. The team was banned from postseason play, including the conference tournament, due to NCAA rules violations.{{cite web|url=https://accsports.com/acc-news/georgia-tech-basketball-banned-from-the-2020-postseason/|title=Georgia Tech Basketball Banned from 2020 Postseason by NCAA|website=accsports.com|first=Brian|last=Geisinger|date=September 26, 2019|accessdate=February 5, 2020}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" style="text-align:center;" !
